deploy.note: Next.js (fumadocs) standalone. The pipeline can deploy this (runtime: node), but it is still skipped until the server side is cut over: the sharpnr-docs systemd unit still points at the old out-of-band location (/media/sharpnrllpDrive/frontends/sharpnr-docs). Install deploy/docs/sharpnr-docs.service first -- otherwise the pipeline copies a new bundle to /var/www/docs, restarts the old unit, and reports success while the site serves the previous build. Remove `skip` once the unit is updated.
